scoped_role: Independent synthetic contributor in existing PR #1327; Amalgam #1278 alone owns canonical model/checkpoint/integration
question: Within the source-only two-slot memory that failed TGAP21, which evaluator interventions rescue return prediction: oracle return-slot selection, pristine earlier A slot restoration, both, or full regime routing? Do not infer native learning gain from privileged interventions.
law: Same *frozen* TGAP21 single-world Bernoulli witness and two-slot research algorithm: role0 or role1 hidden; optimal arm flips at two privately selected boundaries; p(reward=1)=.8 when chosen arm optimal else .2; SHA256 seed:role:step exogenous outcome, no lookahead. Fixed action=step%2 for all policies.

held.recurrence_brier_episodes: steps from second switch to final step, equal observation tape for all arms
held.public_inputs: one public world-step index, chosen action, past witnessed reward; private role/switches/noise ONLY evaluator or specifically labelled diagnostic oracles

arms.baseline: unchanged original TGAP21 fitted two-slot learner; model checkpoint carried into held, public world reset as before; no privileged truth
arms.restore_only_oracle: at second true switch, restore slot0 counts from FIT A snapshot; no active-slot override (privileged intervention; not fair)
arms.route_only_oracle: from second true switch to end, force active=0 before every prediction and witnessed update; preserve contaminated slot0 counts (privileged intervention; not fair)
arms.route_plus_restore_oracle: combine identical return-slot routing and FIT A pristine slot0 restoration at true second switch (privileged, not fair)
arms.full_phase_oracle: before each evaluation step, select slot0 in A/return and slot1 in B; use no hidden labels as training inputs, but this routing itself is privileged upper reference
arms.rolling_8: fully fitted rolling Beta control from identical 72 FIT events, cloned independently to each held world
arms.bayes_hmm: model-informed HMM 0.8/0.2 emission and hazard1/16 known ahead of time, fit on same 72 FIT observations; not equal structural information

metrics.primary: Prequential Brier on final return segment, aggregated by *individual witnessed event* across six frozen worlds and 384 total actions per arm
secondary: Initial role0 vs opposing role1 return Brier
At return, fraction of baseline predictions routed to slot0 (empirical)
Pristine A slot0 readout drift between initial A snapshot and after FIT B, independently verified with cold restore
Exact paired deltas in return Brier: route_only - baseline, restore_only - baseline, combined - baseline
Number of unmodified baseline switches and total action/observation count
Whole CPU execution wall-time excluding checkout, checkpoint bytes and hash
metrics.reporting: Each oracle variant explicitly evaluator-privileged and unusable as claim of scientific advantage. Report negative and contrary improvements without cherry-picking any families.

frozen_decision_rules.route_bottleneck: If baseline return Brier minus route-only oracle Brier >=0.01, return-slot selection is a contributing bottleneck *on this synthetic cohort*.
frozen_decision_rules.contamination_bottleneck: If baseline return Brier minus pristine-only Brier >=0.01, A slot contamination is a contributing bottleneck on this synthetic cohort.
frozen_decision_rules.interaction: If neither individual oracle improves >=0.01 but combined improves >=0.01, report joint intervention interaction, NOT unique attribution.
frozen_decision_rules.full_router_reference: Full phase router is a privileged ceiling and cannot be compared as a fair learner advantage; it may underperform due to corrupted FIT counts.
frozen_decision_rules.engineering: Focused Linux/Windows tests plus exact G29 atlas sealed candidate, dual OS mandatory full regressions and original-source compatibility; source/protocol strict; all 6 worlds, 384 steps/arm; old TGAP21 frozen seeds never reused
frozen_decision_rules.science: Always DEV_NO_GO_SYNTHETIC_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; independent model gain requires matching fully fitted conventional controls and owner-admitted external original-world first use with cold same-address retention, compute and independent replicate
